purpose: Registry of public source families used to discover, normalize, and harden Malware Lineage Atlas data.
rule_zero: A source can create a lead. It cannot create an accepted edge unless the claim is explicit and the relationship type is narrow.
publication_rule: Public availability does not imply redistributable licensing. Prefer links, metadata, and curator-written summaries over copied upstream content.

allowed: sample hashes and labels as metadata
blocked: credentialed threat intel ingestion without explicit review

sources.name: MITRE ATT&CK STIX Data
sources.publication_policy: Allowed in the public repo with MITRE copyright and permission notice preserved. Do not imply MITRE endorsement.
claim_uses: software similarity when wording is explicit
blocked_claim_uses: direct code lineage from technique overlap
operator lineage from group usage alone
sources.notes: Good first-pass source for candidate discovery and stable ATT&CK IDs. Use exact software pages as source records when promoting nodes.

sources.name: Malpedia
sources.publication_policy: Restricted. Use only as local discovery, identity hint, alias hint, and reference pointer. Do not include Malpedia source records, citations, descriptions, YARA rules, references, or API output in the public core dataset.
sources.storage_policy: Local-only notes and source records must stay under data/research/restricted/, which is ignored by git.
blocked_claim_uses: accepted edges without following cited references
sources.notes: Use family pages as identity anchors only when needed. Follow references back to public reports for strong edges. Malpedia site content is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 under its ToS.

sources.name: MISP Galaxy Malpedia Cluster
sources.publication_policy: Usable as a public taxonomy lead source under MISP Galaxy licensing. Still avoid treating taxonomy presence as lineage.
sources.notes: Useful for discovering missing families at scale. Treat as a lead source.

sources.name: MISP Galaxy Ransomware Cluster
sources.publication_policy: Usable as a public taxonomy lead source under MISP Galaxy licensing. Do not infer operator continuity or lineage from cluster membership.
sources.notes: Useful for ransomware coverage breadth, but weak for lineage truth by itself.

sources.name: MalwareBazaar
sources.publication_policy: Metadata-only leads. Do not download or redistribute samples. Respect fair-use/API terms and avoid heavy mirrored datasets.
blocked_claim_uses: accepted lineage from fuzzy hash clusters alone
sources.notes: Use metadata only. Do not download samples through this workflow.

sources.name: URLhaus
sources.publication_policy: Use for infrastructure leads and source links only. Do not mirror large feed content into the core dataset.
blocked_claim_uses: operator lineage from shared infrastructure alone
sources.notes: Useful for distribution and infrastructure context, not ancestry.

sources.name: Ransomware.live
sources.publication_policy: Use for prioritization and links only. Do not mirror victim datasets or ransom-note content into the public repo.
sources.notes: Good for prioritizing active ransomware work. Weak as direct malware lineage evidence.

sources.name: CISA Cybersecurity Advisories
sources.publication_policy: Cite and summarize. Do not use CISA marks or logos as branding.
sources.notes: Use advisories as strong public sources when claims are explicit.

sources.name: DOJ, FBI, Europol, NCA, and partner takedown releases
sources.publication_policy: Cite and summarize legal claims carefully. Do not imply endorsement or copy marks/logos.
blocked_claim_uses: code lineage unless supported by technical analysis
sources.notes: Strong for creator/operator/service links. Preserve legal wording carefully.

sources.name: Public vendor reverse-engineering research
sources.publication_policy: Use report URLs and original curator summaries. Do not copy article text, diagrams, screenshots, or tables.
blocked_claim_uses: vendor label consensus without written evidence
sources.notes: Preferred edge-hardening source class. Use exact report URLs, not broad publisher pages.

sources.name: Peer-reviewed and preprint malware research
sources.publication_policy: Use paper metadata, links, and short claim summaries. Check each paper license before copying figures, tables, or large excerpts.
blocked_claim_uses: claims without public data or reproducible description
sources.notes: Use for broad synthesis and methodology. Preserve paper scope and dates.

sources.name: Cybercrime AI and malicious LLM reporting
sources.publication_policy: Use public report metadata, links, and curator-written summaries. Do not mirror forum posts, screenshots, prompts, model outputs, leaked data, or operational instructions.
blocked_claim_uses: claims that require private forum access
reproducing prompts or malicious generated code
sources.notes: Use only for quarantined adversary-tooling research. Promote to public nodes only when sources distinguish real observed capability from recycled branding or forum hype.
